title: B2-20 · Vocabulary of migration and society

blocks.text: B2-20 · Vocabulary of migration and society

Migrations, communities abroad, integration, demography and social cohesion are themes present every day in the Arab press: in the countries of origin (the remittances, the flight of doctors and engineers, the relationship with communities abroad), in transit countries and in reception countries. They are also themes where words matter: ⁧مُهَاجِر⁩ , ⁧مُغْتَرِب⁩ , ⁧لَاجِئ⁩ and ⁧نَازِح⁩ are not synonymous; "irregular" and "illegal" do not say the same; The wave and flow transform people into water. In this unit you learn the vocabulary of migration and documents, that of society (demographics, inequalities, cohesion, discrimination) and above all to choose and translate words with precision and neutrality, taking up work on connotation (B2-11) and on humanitarian vocabulary (INT-04). Three weeks, in parallel with the end of MAG-01 and with MAG-02.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Reference Grammar (G)70), authentic news chosen by the tutor, sessions with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. distinguish and use with precision ⁧مُهَاجِر⁩ , ⁧مُغْتَرِب⁩ , ⁧لَاجِئ⁩ , ⁧نَازِح⁩ , ⁧طَالِبُ لُجُوءٍ⁩ , ⁧جَالِيَة⁩ ;
2. understand and use the vocabulary of migration and documents (country of origin, transit, reception;
residence permit, visa, reunion, naturalization, repatriation);
3. understanding and using the vocabulary of society: demography, inequalities, cohesion, discrimination;
4. to recognise the words charged and metaphors in the migration news and replace them with neutral terms;
5. to translate a short text on these subjects into two directions with precise lexicon.
